title: On the Effectiveness of the z-Transform Method in Quadratic Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2507.03404v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The z-transform of a sequence is a classical tool used within signal processing, control theory, computer science, and electrical engineering. It allows for studying sequences from their generating functions, with many operations that can be equivalently defined on the original sequence and its $z$-transform. In particular, the z-transform method focuses on asymptotic behaviors and allows the use of Taylor expansions. We present a sequence of results of increasing significance and difficulty for linear models and optimization algorithms, demonstrating the effectiveness and versatility of the z-transform method in deriving new asymptotic results. Starting from the simplest gradient descent iterations in an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space, we show how the spectral dimension characterizes the convergence behavior. We then extend the analysis to Nesterov acceleration, averaging techniques, and stochastic gradient descent.

translated_title: 论 z 变换方法在二次优化中的有效性
translated_abstract: 序列的 z 变换是信号处理、控制理论、计算机科学和电气工程中广泛使用的经典工具。它使得人们能够从生成函数的角度研究序列，且许多运算可以在原始序列及其 z 变换上等价地定义。特别地，z 变换方法专注于渐近行为，并允许使用泰勒展开。我们针对线性模型和优化算法提出了一系列重要性和难度逐级递增的结果，展示了 z 变换方法在推导新渐近结果方面的有效性与通用性。从无限维希尔伯特空间中最简单的梯度下降迭代出发，我们展示了谱维数如何刻画收敛行为，随后将分析扩展到 Nesterov 加速、平均技术和随机梯度下降。
tldr: 该论文展示了 z 变换方法作为推导优化算法新渐近收敛结果的有效工具，从无限维希尔伯特空间中的梯度下降出发，将分析依次扩展至 Nesterov 加速、平均技术和随机梯度下降，并用谱维数刻画收敛行为。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates the effectiveness of the z-transform method in deriving new asymptotic convergence results for optimization algorithms, extending from simple gradient descent in infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces to Nesterov acceleration, averaging techniques, and stochastic gradient descent, with convergence behavior characterized by the spectral dimension.
